pointsOfInterest.name: The Jedi Temple (Ruined)
pointsOfInterest.description: The ancient Jedi Temple, now in ruins after the Empire's purge. Still holds secrets and artifacts for those brave enough to explore.

pointsOfInterest.name: The Galactic Senate Building
pointsOfInterest.description: The seat of the New Republic government. A place of political intrigue, corruption, and power.

pointsOfInterest.name: Underworld Sector U-Scru
pointsOfInterest.description: The dangerous lower levels of Coruscant. A lawless zone where information brokers, criminals, and outcasts operate.

pointsOfInterest.name: Galactic City
pointsOfInterest.description: The main city district of Coruscant, home to the wealthy and powerful. A stark contrast to the underworld below.
